name: hybrid-ssm-8b
provenance: Representative of an attention/state-space hybrid (Nemotron-H-8B class): 24 Mamba layers, 4 attention, 24 MLP. Every dimension and the layer pattern are copied from Nemotron-H's published config (transformers_utils/configs/nemotron_h.py at the pin), not approximated; the attention layers are interleaved at indices 7, 18, 29 and 40 rather than grouped, which is what makes pipeline parallelism give every stage some of each. Not a verified checkpoint config. Present because a recurrent state is constant per request while KV is linear in context -- the two are equal at about 6,200 tokens here -- and because the fixed state forces the attention block size up, which moves block counts and every block hash value.
